KarTEA

class KarTEA[source]

Bases: object

Main class that manages the KarTEA game.

The constructor reads the command line arguments, installs the translation, creates the services, the settings, the game state, the pygame window and the game objects (composition root: everything is created once here and injected where needed).

Attributes:
loggerLog

Application logger (Log.get_log()).

hardwareKarteaHardwareService

Camera and pose tracking configuration.

phase_serviceKarteaPhaseService

Phases and levels read from the phase CSV files.

servicePlayerKarteaConfigService

Player configuration; also provides the session and session detail services, so they share the same sessions DAO.

player_configPlayerKarteaConfig

Configuration of the player given by --player_id (created when missing).

settingsGameSettings

Immutable game configuration built from player_config.

game_stateGameState

Mutable state of the match.

screenpygame.Surface

Game window.

clockpygame.time.Clock

Frame clock, limited to GameSettings.FPS.

fps_fontpygame.font.Font

Font of the FPS counter.

gameGameController

Game logic (track, objects, camera, pose tracking, session).

menuMenu

Start, pause and feedback menus.

statestr

Current screen: "menu" or "game". Starts at "menu".

runningbool

False ends the main loop.

eventslist[pygame.event.Event]

Events of the current frame, read once per frame by handle_events and passed to the GameController.

Notes

  • Command line arguments: --lang (default "pt_BR"), --player_id and --professional_id (default 0).

  • With GameSettings.FULLSCREEN the window is a borderless (pygame.NOFRAME) window of the screen size, on display SCREEN_OS_INDEX, instead of true fullscreen.

get_player_first_name()[source]

Return the first name of the player of this match.

Returns:
str

First word of player_config.player.name (e.g. “Fulano” for “Fulano Silva”), or “” when there is no player or name.

set_game_language(lang_code='pt_BR')[source]

Install the gettext translation of the game.

Parameters:
lang_codestr, optional

Language code, e.g. "pt_BR" (default) or "en_US".

Notes

Installs _() into builtins with the kartea catalog from resources/locales. A missing catalog falls back to the source texts (pt_BR).

handle_events()[source]

Handle the global user events.

Reads the pygame queue once per frame and keeps the events in self.events for the GameController.

Notes

  • Closing the window, Esc or Q exit the game; Q also closes the OpenCV “Tela de Captura” window.

  • The Space key (pause) is handled by the GameController, which records the pause event.

exit_game(by_feet=False)[source]

Record the exit in the session (if any) and end the loop.

Parameters:
by_feetbool, optional

True if the player chose to exit with the feet. Defaults to False.

Notes

The exit is recorded only on the first call (while running is True).

update_menu()[source]

Update the menu and handle the state transitions.

Notes

  • With feet click enabled (GameState.feet_click), the camera and feet tracking keep running in the menus, so the feet can trigger the buttons.

  • Choices made with the feet are recorded as “Controle do Jogador”; with mouse/keyboard, as “Controle UFE”.

  • "game" (Play or Continue) and "play" (feedback screen) are recorded only when chosen with the feet: with mouse/keyboard, the Unpause is recorded when the game resumes, and the level result was already applied and saved by the GameController.

  • "prev", "rest" and "next" (pause menu) are recorded before the level changes, so the event carries the source phase/level; the level is then reset.

update_game()[source]

Update the game logic and go back to the menu when asked.

Notes

The level clock advances in the GameController, using the delta time of the GameState.

update()[source]

Update the current screen (menu or game).

draw_fps()[source]

Draw the FPS counter in the top left corner.

Notes

Drawn only when GameSettings.DRAW_FPS is True.

run()[source]

Run the main game loop.

Notes

  • Each frame handles the events, waits for GameSettings.FPS and sets GameState.delta_time to the real elapsed time in seconds, capped at GameSettings.MAX_DELTA_TIME.

  • On any exit, including errors, the session is saved one last time (so the level in progress also reaches the session) and pygame is shut down. A failure while saving is logged and does not hide the original error.
